data.one_liner: Flutter widgets to easily integrate blocs and cubits for state management.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets like BlocBuilder, BlocListener, and BlocProvider to help integrate BLoC and Cubit state management instances into the Flutter widget tree. It manages lifecycle, dependency injection, and state reactions without requiring code generation.
use_when: You are using the bloc package for state management in Flutter
You need a structured way to separate business logic from UI
You want to inject blocs into the widget tree and rebuild on state changes
avoid_when: You prefer a simpler or less boilerplate-heavy state management solution like riverpod
You are not using the bloc package
strengths: Tight integration with the bloc state management library
Reduces boilerplate compared to using raw StreamBuilders
weaknesses: Can introduce significant boilerplate for simple states
Steeper learning curve for developers new to the BLoC pattern

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the core state management logic without the Flutter widget bindings.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a modern, compile-safe state management library with less boilerplate.
